systemic_finding.observation: Each view ends with exactly one ambiguous label: 4 in total. The recurring mechanism is the same in all four - a label whose own route has no free cell inside the canvas extent is placed on a clear slot near a sibling route (a parallel run or a corner). Two renderer behaviours drive it: consecutive edges leaving one node get adjacent ports (2 cells apart in v2/v4), so a fan cannot host 16-20 character labels in its band; and the label search keeps a clear-but-far slot when its own route offers none.
systemic_finding.gate_status: the round-04 requirement '0 ambiguous owners total' is NOT met: 4 ambiguous owners across 4 views
systemic_finding.what_would_lift_it: a fifth view to thin the hub bands (over the 4-view budget), wider port spread per node, or a label search that refuses an anchor which is not strictly nearest to its own route
